comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
The recipe for this color-customizable foot equip is 2/3rds accurate according to JP wiki - in place of gold, a single Metalwork is required; when you have accumulated a total of 130,000 Roman Coins (dungeon gains do not count) on a character it will appear in Florence from Lorenzo's casting maid, Zita.

As you can only hold a maximum of 50k Roman Coins at a time, you must collect/spend them at lot - it's not easily done so I expect few in Maris will have the ability to produce this item. The +1 Repair version is different and only available from the Greaves Award item.

Source: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?Recipe/Special
